findings.text: the analytic panel sets current = reference for column 0, so _draw_nulls runs twice on the same coordinate set and the red small panel-state markers, drawn second, overpaint the blue large reference markers; the three-candidate saddle cluster, whose separations are 19.8, 27.7 and 23.0 mm against a panel spanning metres, therefore reads as one marker set, and the per-panel caption at line 303 says only Analytic input, so the figure does not show the cluster it measured even though the receipt's cluster table and the figure-level supxlabel carry the facts.

the node's own scheduler log records 1276138.0 python3 CANCELLED with exit code 0:15, elapsed 00:32:14 and MaxRSS 10884K beside the COMPLETED job, batch and extern rows; neither the manifest nor the final report nor the appended records mention this cancelled python step, which spans the whole run, so a reader auditing the node's logs meets an unexplained row, and the measurement's own completion rests on MEASUREMENT_COMPLETE and EXIT=0 in measure-1276138.log plus the validated artefacts rather than on an adjudicated scheduler record.

the position-bound refusal in require_converged is never exercised on this workload: the diverted arms pass it (0.08206281404416836 m against the bound 0.15145387287104764 m), the reactor-static arms skip it because no reference saddle is admitted, and both recorded refusals come from the residual clause that precedes it, so the clause that would catch a converged-but-mislocated terminal state is driven by nothing in this measurement or in any test.

the landed paragraph names a solver defect, but the plan's own adjacent paragraph states the certificate converges in two trips at this rung, and the two receipts are for different carrier identities (the certificate's solovev:diverted-single-null:-110 against the arms' rebuilt analytic-hex construction, whose trip-1 residual 0.15210159579534352 differs from the certificate's first-trip live residual 0.10437452416806733); the arm records carry no carrier identity field, so a reader cannot separate a solver defect from a construction difference without reading the module, and one clause naming the discriminator would settle it.

item_verdicts.done_when: every named clause is evidenced: the one-trip arms reproduce the plan's 0.152 and 0.0471 within one percent and the module asserts it (line 442; 0.15210159579534352 and 0.04707896271873737); the figure has six panels, every panel axis_off true with 14 to 21 contour segments, the authored wall units and both null sets; the analytic cluster's three candidates sit 0.019766091674426882, 0.027681523226844612 and 0.023040394822381856 m apart with per-candidate uncertainty radius 1.653979811200153e-13 m and quadratic merge radius 8.609155933700529e-15 m, all three pairs failing both criteria, with positive controls showing the uncertainty instrument responds to a nonzero gradient and that coincident roots do merge; both forced-one-trip controls refused at the residual clause; and with no default arm converged the receipt and the appended records carry the per-trip residuals and the solver-defect disposition, the section's declared status staying with the coordinator as the worker contract requires.
item_verdicts.goal: the node is on the plan's live escape branch and executed it as written: both default-policy arms settle without converging (ACTIVE_SET_SETTLED, termination_reason 10, 7 and 3 trips, residual 0.15210120896035068 and 0.04707617032680829 against the 1e-12 certificate tolerance); the receipt carries per-trip residual histories of length 7 and 3 with the converged flag, trip count, terminal axis and X-point per arm; the figure exists as PNG with its SVG beside it under docs/figures/plasma-cell-read-fidelity/ through the committed painters; and the plan's landing paragraph and the topology landed record state the nonconvergence with the per-trip residuals and name gs-absolute-accuracy-gates as the solver owner instead of presenting the truncated state as terminal.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at the run directory: status complete, the three commits, the gate command with EXIT=0 and the CPU control job, both refusals, the artifact check and three document audits, one H200 job with no Titan fallback, and the measured numbers; reckon crew check-manifest passed with no findings and its log is in the run directory; the receipt's revision field names b67d45901 and the module is byte-identical between that commit and the reviewed head, so the recorded revision is the code that produced the numbers.
item_verdicts.write_paths: all three commits sit inside the manifest's orientation_write_paths: benchmarks/plasma_cell_terminal_state.py, the six files under docs/figures/plasma-cell-read-fidelity/, docs/plans/plasma-cell-read-fidelity.html and the two landed evidence records; the topology record is another plan's shared landing file, amended under this plan's own instruction to amend its terminal-polish section, 4 inserted lines and 0 deleted; the appendices are insertions only and git status --porcelain at the reviewed head is empty.

justifications.durability: the benchmark re-checks its own guard every run (the forced-one-trip mutation runs inside measure and requires the refusal) and the receipt and figure are committed artefacts, but nothing in the repository re-runs the benchmark: no test file is added and pyproject's testpaths collects tests/ and named nova modules only, so benchmarks/plasma_cell_terminal_state.py sits outside the lane, and one of the two refusal clauses in require_converged is dead on this workload, the position-bound clause at line 229 passing at 0.08206 m against 0.15145 m for the diverted arms and skipped for the reactor-static arms whose reference saddle is not admitted.
justifications.evidence: I reproduced the load-bearing claims from the artefacts rather than reading them: the receipt's per-trip histories, bounds, arm flags and job identity, the PNG digest 6ed8a6be4f2c2785fde868729a5d3964e057c272d66f693c5b1da149b9a94fc9 matching the manifest, the measured module byte-identical across the commits and the head, the negative-control refusals with their verbatim reasons, and the instrument controls whose positive arm reports a nonzero-gradient case rather than the arithmetic floor; beyond the node, the certificate's reduced receipt for the diverted case at 132 cells converges in two trips at 5.291367049957982e-15 with carrier identity solovev:diverted-single-null:-110, which is the fragment the landed disposition leaves unreconciled, and the node's own scheduler.log carries an unadjudicated 1276138.0 python3 CANCELLED row spanning the run.
justifications.fit: benchmarks/plasma_cell_terminal_state.py is named for the mechanism it measures and carries no plan, sprint or ticket label in any symbol, path or comment; the three commits carry conventional subjects with bodies and no attribution; the receipt beside the figure, the nova.media painters, and the measurement delegated to one shared-GPU job follow the repository's existing benchmark and gate idioms.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the fallback the plan authorizes is the branch that ran, and it is executed to the letter: the nonconvergence is preserved with per-trip residuals, the earlier panel is identified as the first trip, the owner is named, and the one-trip states reproduce the plan's numbers, so the deliverable answers the lead's reading of the figure; the deductions are the analytic panel, which draws the reference null set a second time as the panel-state set so the three-candidate cluster renders as one overpainted marker set, and the landed disposition paragraph, which says solver defect beside the plan's own sentence that the certificate converges in two trips at the same rung without naming the discriminator, the two receipts being for different carrier identities.
justifications.scope_discipline: the reviewed worktree at 3d2222f9e is clean, every committed path is inside the declared fence, nothing under nova/ changes, and the node deliberately left the plan's driving followup, section status and metadata untouched because its contract forbids plan-state mutation, stating the division in the manifest and the final report.
